Where the qualification certificate does not mention the specialisation, or the nomenclature differs from what is prescribed, applicants must submit a Certificate of Specialisation or Certificate of Equivalence from their institute. A "Diploma" for eligibility purposes must be a Post-Graduate level course; if this is not explicitly reflected on the certificate, a Certificate of Equivalence is mandatory.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will draw pay as per the IDA scale of the advertised grade, along with Dearness Allowance, perks and allowances, UG Allowance, NPS and PF employer contributions, PRP (as per DPE guidelines), gratuity, medical benefits, and leave encashment as per HCL rules. | Candidates from Government/CPSEs will be given pay protection (last drawn Basic pay and DA only), subject to their application being routed through proper channel or an NOC being submitted at the time of interview.

selection_process: Selection for HCL Recruitment 2026 is based solely on performance in the Personal Interview. There is no written examination mentioned in the notification.
Candidates are shortlisted for Personal Interview in a ratio of 1:5
subject to a minimum of 10 candidates
or as decided by HCL. If applications received exceed the zone of consideration
shortlisting is done by awarding marks: 1 mark for every completed year of relevant experience beyond the minimum requirement
and up to 2 marks for additional higher qualification in the relevant discipline. In case of a tie
candidates from organisations with higher turnover are ranked higher. HCL reserves the right to interview more or fewer candidates than the standard ratio
and to add further shortlisting criteria if required.
how_to_apply: HCL Recruitment 2026 does not have an online application facility. Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed format.
Download the prescribed application proforma (Annexure-I) from the official notification.
Fill the application (typed or neatly handwritten) completely, for each advertised post applied for.

Attach all supporting documents listed in Paragraph 10(iv) of the notification, establishing eligibility for qualification and experience. Candidates who prefer to submit an NOC at the time of interview may send the application without it, on a provisional basis.
Superscribe the envelope with the Post Name, Cadre, and Grade applied for.

Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier only (no email, fax, or hand delivery accepted) to: Executive Director (HR) Hindustan Copper Limited Tamra Bhavan, 1, Ashutosh Chowdhury Avenue Kolkata - 700019
Ensure the application reaches the above address on or before 08/10/2026.

Candidates are advised to apply well in advance rather than waiting for the closing date, since incomplete applications, applications received after the deadline, or those not routed through the proper channel (for candidates from Government organisations/PSUs) are liable to be rejected.
important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals aged 18 years and above are eligible to apply. Appointment is subject to medical fitness and verification of character, antecedents, and caste/category certificates. Any canvassing, directly or indirectly, will disqualify the candidature. Travelling ticket fare is reimbursed only to candidates who are actually interviewed. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising from this recruitment is Kolkata only. In case of any conflict between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version prevails.

content_sections.heading: HCL GM & DGM Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the HCL General Manager and Deputy General Manager Recruitment 2026 should note the following dates:

rows.event: Date of Reckoning (for age, qualification, experience)

content_sections.heading: HCL GM & DGM Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across two grades and four disciplines. One post is reserved for the VH category under Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Total: 4 General Manager (E8) posts and 6 Deputy General Manager (E7) posts. Mining discipline is not identified as suitable for PwBD candidates; PwBD categories are identified only for Human Resource, Finance, and Materials & Contracts disciplines, as detailed in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: HCL GM & DGM Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility for HCL Recruitment 2026 depends on the discipline applied for. The essential qualification for each discipline is given below. Equivalent qualifications are considered as per Government/UGC/AIU/AICTE guidelines. Where the qualification certificate does not mention the specialisation, or the nomenclature differs from what is prescribed, applicants must submit a Certificate of Specialisation or Certificate of Equivalence from their institute. A "Diploma" for eligibility purposes must be a Post-Graduate level course; if this is not explicitly reflected on the certificate, a Certificate of Equivalence is mandatory.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Mining Engineering with First Class Mine Manager's Certificate of Competency (Unrestricted) under the Metalliferous Mines Regulations. The Certificate of Competency is qualifying in nature; post-qualification experience is counted from the date of the Bachelor's Degree in Mining Engineering.

Bachelor's Degree in Arts/Commerce/Science/Engineering/Professional Studies (BBA/BCA etc.) with an MBA specialising in Personnel Management, or a Post-Graduate Degree/Diploma in Personnel Management/Social Work acceptable under Labour Legislation for a Welfare Officer. Preference is given to candidates additionally holding an LLB.
Passed the Final Examination of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) or the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI).

Bachelor's Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Engineering with a Post-Graduate Degree/Diploma in Materials Management/Supply Chain Management/Logistics & Supply Chain Management, OR a Bachelor's Degree with an MBA specialising in the same fields.

content_sections.heading: HCL GM & DGM Age Limit and Post-Qualification Experience
content_sections.text: Age relaxation of 5 years is admissible for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, 5 years for Ex-Servicemen, and as per Government of India guidelines for PwD candidates - applicable to external applicants, up to the extent that leaves a minimum residual service of 3 years before superannuation. Internal HCL employees applying on a regular basis do not have a maximum age limit, but must have completed at least one year of service in the next-below scale of pay and must meet the prescribed post-qualification experience. Experience is counted only from the date of obtaining the essential qualification, must be in the relevant field (Mining/Metal/Manufacturing industry, or another industry with a supporting experience certificate and job description), and does not include teaching, research fellowship, internship, apprenticeship, consultancy, or academic project experience. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Preferred Experience for HCL GM & DGM Posts

rows.preferred_experience: 5 years in underground mining, with sound competency in underground project management/execution, including regulatory compliance for underground mining projects.
5 years in finalisation of accounts, cost accounting, budgeting, MIS, mergers and acquisitions, banking, fund management, taxation, audits, and concurrence of proposals.

5 years handling contract labour matters and labour law compliance in a large project/unit, long-term wage settlements in a multi-unit CPSU, bipartite/tripartite settlements with trade unions, Board-level matters, and service matters before legal fora such as CGIT, CAT, and High Court/Supreme Court.

5 years in a senior managerial position with experience in materials planning, inventory control, vendor development, supply chain and logistics management, ERP systems, and E-Tendering (GeM, CPPP), preferably in the Mining/Metal industry.

content_sections.heading: HCL GM & DGM Salary and Cost to Company (CTC)
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will draw pay as per the IDA scale of the advertised grade, along with Dearness Allowance, perks and allowances, UG Allowance, NPS and PF employer contributions, PRP (as per DPE guidelines), gratuity, medical benefits, and leave encashment as per HCL rules. Candidates from Government/CPSEs will be given pay protection (last drawn Basic pay and DA only), subject to their application being routed through proper channel or an NOC being submitted at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: HCL GM & DGM Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for HCL Recruitment 2026 is based solely on performance in the Personal Interview. There is no written examination mentioned in the notification. Candidates are shortlisted for Personal Interview in a ratio of 1:5, subject to a minimum of 10 candidates, or as decided by HCL. If applications received exceed the zone of consideration, shortlisting is done by awarding marks: 1 mark for every completed year of relevant experience beyond the minimum requirement, and up to 2 marks for additional higher qualification in the relevant discipline. In case of a tie, candidates from organisations with higher turnover are ranked higher. HCL reserves the right to interview more or fewer candidates than the standard ratio, and to add further shortlisting criteria if required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HCL General Manager & Deputy General Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: HCL Recruitment 2026 does not have an online application facility. Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed format. Download the prescribed application proforma (Annexure-I) from the official notification. Fill the application (typed or neatly handwritten) completely, for each advertised post applied for. Attach all supporting documents listed in Paragraph 10(iv) of the notification, establishing eligibility for qualification and experience. Candidates who prefer to submit an NOC at the time of interview may send the application without it, on a provisional basis. Superscribe the envelope with the Post Name, Cadre, and Grade applied for. Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier only (no email, fax, or hand delivery accepted) to: Executive Director (HR) Hindustan Copper Limited Tamra Bhavan, 1, Ashutosh Chowdhury Avenue Kolkata - 700019 Ensure the application reaches the above address on or before 08/10/2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance rather than waiting for the closing date, since incomplete applications, applications received after the deadline, or those not routed through the proper channel (for candidates from Government organisations/PSUs) are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HCL GM & DGM Document Verification
content_sections.text: Candidates called for Personal Interview must carry original documents for verification, including: Date of Birth proof (10th Standard certificate or School Leaving Certificate) 12th Standard Passing Certificate/Mark Statement Graduate and/or Post-Graduate/Professional Qualification mark sheets and certificates Experience certificates for each declared organisation, along with supporting proof such as appointment letter, release letter, PF statement, Form-16, pay slips, and bank statements NOC and proof of parallel/next-below grade, if presently working in a PSU/Government organisation Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer) or Disability Certificate for PwBD candidates, in the prescribed Government of India format Valid ID proof (Aadhaar/Driving Licence/Voter ID/Passport) Non-production of original documents at the interview will debar the candidate from appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is HCL General Manager & Deputy General Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Hindustan Copper Limited, under Notification No. Estt./1/2035/2026-27 dated 09/09/2026, to fill 10 posts of General Manager (E8) and Deputy General Manager (E7) in Mining, HR, Finance, and Materials & Contracts disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HCL GM & DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies in total: 4 General Manager posts (3 Mining, 1 HR) and 6 Deputy General Manager posts (2 Mining, 2 Finance, 1 HR, 1 Materials & Contracts).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the application to reach HCL's Corporate Office in Kolkata is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HCL GM & DGM posts?
faq.answer: It varies by discipline: a Mining Engineering degree with a First Class Mine Manager's Certificate of Competency for Mining; an MBA in Personnel Management or equivalent PG qualification for HR; ICAI or ICMAI final qualification for Finance; and a PG Degree/Diploma or MBA in Materials/Supply Chain Management for Materials & Contracts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HCL GM & DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 56 years for General Manager (E8) and 55 years for Deputy General Manager (E7), for external candidates, with applicable age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen. Internal HCL employees have no maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for HCL GM & DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Candidates must send the filled Annexure-I application form with supporting documents by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier to the Executive Director (HR), Hindustan Copper Limited, Kolkata, on or before 08/10/2026.
